question: In which ritual supports should the prescribed procedure be performed in this manner?
premises: The procedure applies to an image.
The procedure applies alternatively to Sadāśiva.
The procedure applies also to a liṅga.
inference: One should perform the procedure in this manner in the image, in Sadāśiva, or in the liṅga.
plain_english: One should perform it in this way in the image, or in Sadāśiva, and likewise in the liṅga.
